Looking at the provided code and error message, I can see several issues that need to be fixed. Let me analyze the problems:

1. The code is using incorrect tile dimensions - it's using `tiles` for both I and J dimensions but should calculate them separately
2. The scratchpad layout calculation for B matrix is incorrect
3. The output reading logic has issues with BF16 packing
4. The tile padding logic needs to be adjusted properly

Let me provide the corrected code:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (1x1024x3072).
void solution(void) {
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++)
   for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Calculate tile counts
      int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division
      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      
      // PROF cpu_stage
      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales; A/B data is mvin'd DIRECTLY
      // from DRAM (no host-side block memcpy — that was 98% of the cycles).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0;  // Use beginning of accumulator
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows;
      int pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;
      
      // PROF accel
      gemmini_flush(0);
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);
      
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));      // A rows: stride K (full block-aligned tiles)
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          int dram_row = i0 * BLK + i * DIM;
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + dram_row * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
                                
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));      // B rows: stride N
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++)                  // Pack B contiguously as (j * tiles_K + k)
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          int dram_row = k * DIM;
          int dram_col = j0 * BLK + j * DIM;
          gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + dram_row * MATMUL_N + dram_col),
                                 b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
                                
      gemmini_config_st(BLK_OUTC * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
                           
      // Accelerator-centric readout: per-row hardware DMA from smem straight into the
      // bf16-packed row-major output
      int output_rows = tiles_I * DIM - pad_i;
      int output_cols = tiles_J * DIM - pad_j;
      
      for (int r = 0; r < output_rows; r++) {
        int dram_row = i0 * BLK + r;
        int dram_col_start = (j0 * BLK) / BF16_PER_WORD;
        int smem_offset = SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * (tiles_J * DIM);
        int num_bf16 = output_cols;
        
        if (r < mrows) {  // Only read valid rows
          gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[dram_row][dram_col_start], smem_offset, num_bf16);
        }
      }
      gemmini_fence();
    }
}
```
